A [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''tree''' grew near a [[Unidentified villa|villa]] on the<ref name="Rebirth" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The [[Tree/Legends|tree's]] leaves resembled feathers, and its bark was scored with [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]]-shaped patterns.<ref name="Rebirth" /> In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] attempted to avoid fellow Jedi [[Kyp Durron]] because she believed that the latter would ask her to be his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmate]]. Ultimately, Durron was able to find Solo, who greeted him as he passed a groomed stand that contained one such tree.<ref name="Rebirth" />

==Behind the scenes==
The tree appeared in [[Greg Keyes]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the second volume of the ''[[Edge of Victory Duology]]'', which was itself a part of the series ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]''.<ref name="Rebirth" />
